data.one_liner: Plugin to generate and print PDFs on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux and web
data.what_it_does: It lets Flutter apps create PDF documents using the pdf package and send them to native print services or share them. It also provides a PdfPreview widget for displaying PDFs in the app.
use_when: Need to print or share PDFs from a Flutter app
Want a preview widget that auto‑reloads PDFs during development
Need to convert HTML to PDF on the fly
avoid_when: You only need to display static images or text without printing
Your app targets a single platform and you prefer a lightweight solution
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, web)
Supports PDF conversion from HTML and image assets
Handles PDF encryption and digital signatures
weaknesses: Requires native configuration on each platform (iOS Swift, macOS entitlements, Windows PDFium)
Large dependency tree (pdf, http, image, etc.)
Some platform bugs fixed only in recent releases
data.setup_notes: iOS: add use_frameworks! to Podfile; macOS: add print entitlement; Windows/Linux: set PDFIUM_VERSION and PDFIUM_ARCH in CMakeLists.txt; web: optional script to set pdf.js version
data.minimal_example:
final doc = pw.Document();
await Printing.layoutPdf(onLayout: (format) async => doc.save());
